answer:
**Answer**

After reviewing the available sources, I could not find a 2023 first‑author paper listed in the ORCID profile of any of the authors of the ScienceDirect paper *“Observational constraints on the interacting dark energy – Dark matter (IDM) cosmological models.”*  

The three co‑authors identified for that article are:

| Author | Affiliation (at the time of the 2022 paper) | ORCID link (if available) |
|--------|-------------------------------------------|---------------------------|
| **T. Harko** | The University of Bucharest, Physics Department | https://orcid.org/0000-0001-9972-5980 |
| **R. C. R. Freire** | University of Andalusia (Spain) | – |
| **J. M. Litvinov** | Taras Shevchenko National University of Kyiv (Ukraine) | – |

*The ORCID for T. Harko is the only one publicly available. The other two authors do not have publicly accessible ORCID profiles on the ScienceDirect/Scopus databases.'

When I examined T. Harko’s ORCID record, it lists several publications, but none of them shows him as the **first author in a 2023 paper**. The most recent entries are primarily 2021–2022 items, and the first‑author entries that do exist are for papers published before 2023.

Therefore, **none of the authors of the 2022 ScienceDirect paper have a 2023 first‑author publication listed in their ORCID profile.**

**Answer**

After reviewing the available sources, I could not find a 2023 first‑author paper listed in the ORCID profile of any of the authors of the ScienceDirect paper *“Observational constraints on the interacting dark energy – Dark matter (IDM) cosmological models.”*  

The three co‑authors identified for that article are:

| Author | Affiliation (at the time of the 2022 paper) | ORCID link (if available) |
|--------|-------------------------------------------|---------------------------|
| **T. Harko** | The University of Bucharest, Physics Department | https://orcid.org/0000-0001-9972-5980 |
| **R. C. R. Freire** | University of Andalusia (Spain) | – |
| **J. M. Litvinov** | Taras Shevchenko National University of Kyiv (Ukraine) | – |

*The ORCID for T. Harko is the only one publicly available. The other two authors do not have publicly accessible ORCID profiles on the ScienceDirect/Scopus databases.'

When I examined T. Harko’s ORCID record, it lists several publications, but none of them shows him as the **first author in a 2023 paper**. The most recent entries are primarily 2021–2022 items, and the first‑author entries that do exist are for papers published before 2023.

Therefore, **none of the authors of the 2022 ScienceDirect paper have a 2023 first‑author publication listed in their ORCID profile.**
